draft_en.subject: 10G / L3 aggregation gap in the Case industrial range — one question
draft_en.body:
Hi, Andy,

In February 2025 you told me plainly that the L3 DIN PoE unit at $500 was more than you pay elsewhere. Fair point, and I have not pushed PoE on you since.

This is about a different slot. Two things in our range today that Case does not list:

- Industrial 10G uplink access: STI-488XGGPM, 8× GE PoE+ + 4× 10G SFP+, L2+ (Marvell), -40 to +75 °C, DIN-rail — $171.9 USD EXW, MOQ 1 pc, 15-day validity.
- Full-L3 aggregation on our CENTEC line: STH-2C24XF-HSI, 24× 10G SFP+ + 2× 100G, OSPF/BGP/MPLS, dual hot-swap PSU — $1,500 USD EXW, built to order.

Both can carry the Case label (software logo from one unit; overlay and box from 300 / 200 pcs).

One question: is there a 10G-uplink or L3 aggregation gap in your industrial range where one of these would fill a hole rather than duplicate what you already buy? If not, I will leave it there.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
